$comment: U-088: the campaign as data. `missions` is the order the squad plays them in, a straight line (design doc D3): each entry names a registered mission (its world id) and carries the text the host sees: a title, a short briefing before it and a short debrief after it, as lines. The first entry is the slice's mission-01 with text for the mission as it plays today; U-065 replaces it with campaign mission 1. To add a mission: register it (campaignRegistry.ts), then add one entry here. Nothing else changes. U-077: `replayKeepsLoadout` says the loadout a replay run ends with is kept for the campaign (from design doc D6; the owner confirmed it 2026-10-02); false means a replay keeps nothing.

missions.title: Mission 01 — The qalat on the ridge road
briefing: A walled compound on the ridge road is being used to watch our convoys. Take it, and put the relay at its terminal on our network.
Two fireteams, two ways in. Expect a patrol on the west lane and men waiting on the east, and a counterattack once you are inside. Hold the terminal until the upload completes.
debrief: The relay is ours and the road is watched by us now.
The compound is a foothold, not a victory. The next mission starts from here.
